_purpose: Verified code-to-label lookups for the EICV7 cross-section extract (catalog 119). Every entry below was read from the value labels inside CS_EICV7_poverty_file.dta, not guessed from a codebook or from another round. scripts/import_eicv7.py consumes the same shape through eicv7_map.json; this file keeps the lookups readable on their own.
_note: The district label set matches all 30 names in data/processed/districts.json exactly, so no manual name normalisation is needed. Province labels in the extract carry the word 'Province'; the contract uses the short form.

poverty_flags._why: The extract's own published classification. Recomputing from cons1ae against the lines gives 41.5%, because the two are not on the same price base.
